label: Seven DOC Great Walks published on Google Street View
summary: Google published seven Great Walks as 360-degree Street View trails, following a DOC collaboration with geospatial teams, local iwi and track staff dating back to 2012.

sources.label: Department of Conservation, The Great Walks on Google Maps, 6 November 2015
Google New Zealand, Take a walk on the wild side with Street View in New Zealand, 4 November 2015
